title: Answer: a physical account of how history acts on a system

statements.text: The conclusion would fall to a theory that gives up local-state sufficiency with a specified physical account of how historical information is carried and acts while locality, conservation and well-posed evolution are kept, or to a theory without a dynamically sufficient local state, which the paper sets outside its scope.

sources.quote: A genuine departure must explain how the historical information is carried, how it affects the system, and how locality, conservation laws, and well-posed physical evolution are preserved
